text:
maria: Hey team — Atlas AI POC ready to sign a 6mo dedicated commit but they want a blended GPU pool (4xA100 + 8xL40) and a softened burst rate. Can we get slab pricing + a provisional carveout for autoscale burst credits? They mentioned a strict per-token budget for peak spikes.

Tom: Can you share expected sustained qps and peak spike percent? autoscale/burst cost depends a lot on burst window.

maria: baseline steady-state ~220 qps, peaks up to ~1200 qps for 2–3 min bursts (about 4x baseline), maybe 40–50% of days have 1–2 spikes. They want burst credit cap so monthly cost is predictable.

jess: For a 6mo commit we usually offer tiered slab discounts. Rough sketch: commit discount on reserved vGPU hours, plus a burst-credit pool at a discounted uplift (e.g., +25% over base rate) instead of on-demand. Do they want a single monthly charge or metered burst usage?

maria: they'd prefer a single predictable monthly line item that covers X guaranteed capacity + Y capped burst spend. Sales wants a provisional rate we can include in the SOW.

anand: Operational note — Mixed pools are fine but autoscale policies must bind to a fallback model variant to keep latency SLOs. Also L40s behave differently for quantized models; need to validate perf.

Tom: Got it. I'll draft a perf matrix but for pricing we need an assumed effective GPU-hour split. If they commit 4 A100 + 8 L40 reserved, that’s a baseline. For burst cap we can offer a pre-allocated burst credit bucket (e.g., 1200 GPU-hours/month) priced at a blended burst rate.

maria: Can we price that bucket at ~1.6x base reserved rate? Customer wants max uplift 1.75x.

jess: 1.6x is within typical range for short-term burst credits on mixed pools. If we lock it in on a 6mo commit we can do 1.5x for first 3 months as promo, then 1.6x thereafter. Requires Deal Desk approval for promo.

maria: They asked about autoscale grace — can we allow a 10% tolerance beyond the burst bucket in emergencies (billing reconciliation after the month)?

anand: We can add a safety buffer for emergency auto-burst but it has to be throttled and meter-logged. We can also include a hard cap that triggers fallback to cheaper variant.

tom: For the SOW line items I suggest: 
- Reserved: 4xA100 + 8xL40 (monthly equivalent hours) — price P_reserve
- Burst credit bucket: 1200 GPU-hours @ 1.6x blended burst rate — price P_burst
- Emergency tolerance: 10% soft buffer (metered, reconciled)

maria: Jess — can you run numbers and open a Deal Desk case? Need provisional approval to share with Atlas tomorrow.

jess: Opening case now. Will include pricing calc and legal checklist. ETA 4h.

deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk request created: DD-4321. Requesting provisional pricing approval: 6mo mixed GPU commit + 1200-hour burst bucket @ 1.6x, promo of 1.5x for months 1–3. Assigned to: jess.

maria: tagging @anand — can you confirm we can validate L40 perf for their top-3 models within 48h? They want that before signing.

anand: Yes — will schedule perf runs tonight. If quantization issues show up we'll flag and propose fallback quantized variant or additional reserved A100 hours.

tom: Also need to surface SLA implications: burst fallback to cheaper variant increases 95p latency by ~30–60ms in our tests. Are they ok?

maria: I'll confirm with Atlas; they said latency tolerance up to 200ms 95p. Should be fine but will double-check.

jess: Deal Desk DD-4321 updated with model validation plan, SLA footnotes, and comptroller billing example. Attaching internal ratecard snippet: 
```
# simplified
A100 reserved base: $X/hr
L40 reserved base: $Y/hr
Blended reserved = (4*X + 8*Y)/12
Burst uplift = 1.6 * Blended reserved
Burst promo (mo1-3) = 1.5 * Blended reserved
```

maria: Perfect. If Deal Desk approves provisional pricing, I'll send a one-page commercial summary + perf SLA to Atlas.

deal-desk-bot: DD-4321 status: awaiting review (jess).

tom: FYI — if legal needs a carveout clause, we usually add an "autoscale burst cap" appendix with monthly burst bucket and emergency reconciliation terms.

maria: Thanks all — pinging again when DD-4321 lands approved. :pray: 

jess: Will update in-thread when decision is made.

deal-desk-bot: DD-4321 updated: provisional pricing approved by revops (jess) pending finance sign-off.

maria: Awesome — finance sign-off needed on the promo. @jess can you escalate to finance?

jess: Escalating now, will push for EOD sign-off.

anand: Perf runs queued. Will post results in this thread when done.

maria: Thanks, team.
